subject: Risk & Compliance
title: AI Governance in Corporations
description: Learn AI Governance in Corporations in one minute.

hook.text: A company's AI denies loans to minorities. The board didn't know the algorithm existed. They're still liable.

buildup.text: AI governance ensures companies oversee how algorithms make decisions that affect customers and employees.

discovery.text: The EU AI Act classifies AI systems by risk and requires oversight for high-risk applications like hiring and lending.

twist.text: Most boards don't understand AI. But regulators hold them responsible for its outcomes anyway.

climax.text: AI governance is the next frontier. Boards must understand what their algorithms do before regulators ask.

punchline.text: Your AI discriminates. Your board is liable. Understand it.

quiz.question: What does the EU AI Act do?
options: Classifies AI by risk and requires oversight for high-risk uses
Bans all artificial intelligence in Europe
Requires companies to open-source all AI
